payload.reason: The evidence indicates that regularization during fine-tuning does not harm performance in the target domain, and may even help recover performance in the source domain.

claims.text: Regularization of the fine-tuning process does not harm performance in the target domain.
A combination of auxiliary penalty terms consistently produces the best recovery for the source domain without harming performance in the target domain.
Experiments show that fine-tuning with regularization can be applied to multiple domains without negative impact on target domain performance.
